_comment: The half of the registry that cannot come from a chain. Legal structure, custody, redemption rights and dividend treatment live in documents an issuer publishes, so each one is curated here with links to its source. Everything else (supply, authorities, extensions, depth, prices) is read live and must never be written here. `checkedAt` is the date these facts were last checked against public sources; `attestation: Unverified` means Arclis has not confirmed a published attestation schedule, which is not the same as there being none.

issuers.name: xStocks (Backed Finance)
issuers.jurisdiction: Jersey; base prospectus approved in Liechtenstein
issuers.structure: Tracker certificate, collateralised 1:1 by the underlying share, issued under a bankruptcy-remote structure

issuers.name: Ondo Global Markets
issuers.jurisdiction: British Virgin Islands; not offered to US persons
issuers.structure: Structured note issued by a bankruptcy-remote SPV, backed 1:1 by shares held at US-registered broker-dealers

issuers.name: Backpack Securities
issuers.structure: Tokenized security entitlement; each token backed 1:1 by a share held in US broker-dealer custody under New York UCC Article 8

issuers.name: PreStocks
issuers.jurisdiction: Not stated in the sources Arclis checked
issuers.structure: Token giving economic exposure to interests in SPVs that hold pre-IPO shares directly or indirectly

tokens.name: Apple Inc.
tokens.custodian: Alpaca Securities LLC, with InCore Bank AG as backup
tokens.dividendTreatment: Reinvested. On Solana the token's display multiplier (the Scaled UI amount extension) rises instead of cash being paid.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Splits are reflected through the same display multiplier, adjusted by the issuer.
tokens.issuerRisk: You hold a certificate issued by Backed, not the share itself. If the issuer fails, the bankruptcy-remote structure and a security agent stand between you and the collateral; you are not an Apple shareholder.

tokens.name: Apple Inc.
tokens.dividendTreatment: Total return. Dividends are reinvested and show up as more tokens in your balance.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Handled by the issuer at the note level.
tokens.issuerRisk: You hold a note issued by an SPV, not the share. The SPV is bankruptcy-remote, and minting and redemption are open only to eligible, onboarded non-US investors; everyone else exits by selling.

tokens.name: NVIDIA Corporation
tokens.custodian: Alpaca Securities LLC, with InCore Bank AG as backup
tokens.dividendTreatment: Reinvested through the display multiplier. NVIDIA's yield is small either way.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Splits are reflected through the display multiplier, adjusted by the issuer.
tokens.issuerRisk: A certificate claim against Backed's collateral, not a direct NVIDIA holding.

tokens.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A
tokens.custodian: Alpaca Securities LLC, with InCore Bank AG as backup
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Splits are reflected through the display multiplier, adjusted by the issuer.
tokens.issuerRisk: A certificate claim against Backed's collateral, not a direct Alphabet holding.

tokens.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
tokens.custodian: Alpaca Securities LLC, with InCore Bank AG as backup
tokens.dividendTreatment: ETF distributions are reinvested through the display multiplier.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Reflected through the display multiplier, adjusted by the issuer.
tokens.issuerRisk: A certificate claim against Backed's collateral, not a direct holding of the ETF.

tokens.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
tokens.dividendTreatment: Holders are entitled to cash dividends and corporate actions on the underlying share.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Passed through by Backpack Securities as the broker-dealer holding the share.
tokens.issuerRisk: The token is a security entitlement to a real share at a US broker-dealer. Verified holders can redeem it and move the share to another brokerage; unverified holders exit by selling.

tokens.name: OpenAI (pre-IPO exposure)
tokens.dividendTreatment: Not applicable. OpenAI is private and pays no dividend.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Depends on the SPVs behind the token, which hold OpenAI exposure directly or indirectly.
tokens.issuerRisk: You do not own OpenAI shares. The token tracks the issuer's SPV exposure, and with no listed share there is no public price to check it against: the pool is the market.
